audience.en: A retired Japanese couple, Hiroshi (67) and Keiko (64), living in Yokohama with about ¥42 million in savings and a ¥290,000 monthly pension, weighing a 2–3 year stay in Malaysia from autumn 2027: where to base themselves, which visa, and the monthly cost.
audience.ja: 横浜にお住まいで、貯蓄が約¥42百万、年金が月¥290,000の、ヒロシさん（67歳）とケイコさん（64歳）の退職後のご夫妻。2027年の秋から2〜3年のマレーシア滞在を検討しており、拠点にする場所、ビザ、毎月の費用を比べています。

localeReason: The couple are Japanese retirees in Yokohama. Japanese lets them read the visa terms, the Japan-side questions for the ward office, pension service and tax adviser, and the open issues in the language of the offices they will deal with; it changes no rule, fee or eligibility.

planningAssumptions.profile: Hiroshi (67) and Keiko (64), Yokohama, savings ¥42 million, pension ¥290,000 a month, stay of 2–3 years from autumn 2027; no work.
planningAssumptions.exchangeRates: ECB reference rates for 6 November 2026: 1 EUR = 176.77 JPY = 4.5319 MYR = 1.1165 USD; cross rates used 1 MYR = ¥39.00 (exact 39.0057) and 1 USD = ¥158.33. Reference rates, not retail.
planningAssumptions.budget: Rent is the midpoint of undated asking-rent samples (Kuala Lumpur RM 3,400; Penang RM 2,225). Utilities RM 500, groceries RM 2,000, dining RM 1,200, transport RM 600, private insurance placeholder RM 2,500, out-of-pocket medical RM 400, leisure RM 800, Yokohama flat upkeep ¥40,000 a month, Japan visits ¥300,000 a year: all unconfirmed planning placeholders.
planningAssumptions.silverFees: RM 8,500 assumes the RM 5,000 plus RM 2,500 processing fee applies; the source states no trigger.

datePolicy: All sources were read on 2026-11-08 in the original run and that access date is kept. Page dates (for example the Sabah page updated 8 September 2026, a listing dated 31 August 2026, the Yokohama pages updated 2026-10-27 and 2026-02-25) are source dates, not access dates; many pages are undated. Copy editing and translation are not a refresh.
uncertainties: The MOTAC guide and four announcement PDFs, the Sarawak May 2025 guidelines PDF, the Sabah PDFs and the DE Rantau eligibility FAQ were not read; federal figures could be superseded.
Sarawak deposit conflict: undated FAQ says RM 300,000 per couple or RM 150,000 single; a second-hand 2025 news item says RM 500,000 from 1 January 2025. The Sabah tier table could not be parsed.
The 90-day visa-free rule comes only from an undated embassy page; no dated Immigration source was found.

All rents are asking prices from undated search-result summaries (listing sites could not be opened); the Inspirasi unit match is unverified; the Mont Kiara 'typical rent' of RM 6,500–8,000 conflicts and is not used.
Yokohama's own 1-year rule, the effect on 住民票, its 国保 海外療養費 page, Malaysia's pension-tax treatment, and the voluntary pension age limit are unconfirmed.

The case for Kuala Lumpur over Penang rests on one community hospital list (about 40% read) and the absence of Penang evidence. No Penang Japanese clinic or hospital price page, insurer quote or non-Cigna insurer research.

Budget lines other than rent, the insurance placeholder, flat upkeep and flights are assumptions without a source; Malaysian purchase costs, Japanese tax and social-insurance charges are not included.

provenance.sourceAccessMethod: Local files only. The README locale contract and VOICE-GUIDE were read first, then the run's index.html, sources.md and independent-check.md.
